node.statement: Application bridge under the explicit hypotheses of amended node 1.1: because eta<=rho_id^corr<=rho_theta=1/8<1/4, lem-kitaev-almost-idemp-audit applies to the given nonzero H and UCP Phi with ||Phi^2-Phi||_cb<=eta and yields tilde-Phi^2=tilde-Phi and A=Im(tilde-Phi). Because rho_AI=eta_A by node 1.1.1 and eta<=rho_id^corr<=rho_AI, lem-routef-ai-defect-linearization also applies and yields that A is an extended epsilon_AI(eta)-C*-algebra with epsilon_AI(eta)<=C_A*eta. Since H is finite-dimensional, B(H) is finite-dimensional, and its linear subspace A=Im(tilde-Phi) is finite-dimensional. Finally eta<=rho_id^corr<=epsilon_E/C_A and C_A>0 imply C_A*eta<=epsilon_E; thus 0<=epsilon_AI(eta)<=epsilon_E, so lem-thmainext-conditional applies. Its extended isomorphism v:B->A is bijective by def-extended-delta-inclusion, hence has inverse v^(-1):A->B.
